finding: Strengthening K from the selected policy through global 3e-4 and finally exact analytical K does not restore the analytical nonlinear path. The remaining O05-dry prescribed-qbot path drift is therefore not attributable to K approximation.

nonclaims: This does not imply the derivative-consistent theta/C representation is physically inaccurate; the frozen failure is an exact nonlinear-path criterion.
